title: Write about yourself
prompt: Write 2 or 3 sentences about yourself: your name, your city and one thing you like.
model: My name is Amina. I live in Hargeisa. I like reading books.

title: My daily routine
prompt: Write a short paragraph about your daily routine. Use first, then and after that.
model: First, I wake up at six. Then I have breakfast and go to school. After that, I study at home.

title: Ask for information
prompt: Write a short formal email asking a language school about course prices. Start with 'Dear' and end with 'Regards'.
model: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to ask about your English courses. Could you please send me the prices and the start dates? Thank you for your help. Regards, Amina.

title: Reschedule a meeting
prompt: Write a professional email to a colleague asking to reschedule tomorrow's meeting. Give a reason and suggest a new time.
model: Dear Mr Hassan, I am writing to ask whether we could reschedule tomorrow's meeting because I have to meet a client. Would Thursday at ten be convenient? Regards, Amina.

title: Technology and study
prompt: Write a short essay (about 120 words): does technology improve learning? Give two reasons and one counter-argument.
